answer_4.quote: We conducted a short (10-15 minute) listening test to compare the two Tacotron2 models... recruited 30 participants through Prolific, and presented each with four MUSHRA-style questions... For the Kanien'kéha listening test, 6 participants were asked to answer 20 A/B questions... The model received a 3.56 ± 0.26 MOS compared with a MOS for the reference recordings of 4.63 ± 0.19.
answer_4.guideline: Participants performed A/B preference tests, MOS rating tasks and MUSHRA-style comparisons, answering questions about the naturalness, intelligibility and overall acceptability of the synthesized speech.
